transcript_window.text: There's a funny story that happened back in 1988.
There was this undertaker guy named Stroger.
And when someone died, he would get a telephone call to come take care of the body.
And business was doing well for him.
But then suddenly, he started receiving fewer calls.
But he knew people were dying.
See, back then, when you called someone on the phone, you would tell the who you wanted to call.
And they had a patch panel where they would connect a physical cable from your phone to their phone.
And what this undertaker figured out is that the lady who was working as the phone operator, her husband was trying to start an undertaker business.

So any time somebody would call asking for the undertaker, she would just connect them to her husband's So this Stroger guy was so upset that she was intercepting his incoming calls and rerouting them.
And he thought, I bet I can automate her job.
So he set out to work to build an automatic way to connect calls from one person to another without the need of an operator.
And this was the first telephone switch ever invented in 1889, invented because one guy didn't trust humans to connect the calls and decided to use technology to solve his problem.
These are true stories from the dark side of the internet.
